  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))

(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any

)

; ----------------------------

(define-fun Event.before ((this Ref)(e Ref)) Bool

)

)

(define-fun Event.contains ((this Ref)(e Ref)) Bool
  (or (and (<= (Event.startTime this) (Event.startTime e)) (< (Event.endTime e) (Event.endTime this))) (and (< (Event.startTime this) (Event.startTime e)) (<= (Event.endTime e) (Event.endTime this))))
